prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to move the test tube from capping device to shaking device.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: shaking device
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube on shaking device.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: The photo shows a benchtop rocker/shaker on a white surface against a pale wall. At right is a white rectangular control unit with a dark grey top panel, a round grey knob, and printed labels. Extending to the left is a black platform/rack with two rows of circular holes (roughly ten visible openings, most empty), mounted on a black L-shaped bracket with a green-and-white label at its base. In the leftmost hole stands an upright clear vial capped with an orange-red screw cap; it holds a whitish, cloudy liquid partway up. A white card with a black square fiducial marker and the number "621" lies flat on the platform between the holes. Dark strips lie on the surface in the foreground.
observations: The shaker platform holds an upright clear tube/vial in the leftmost hole, sealed with an orange-red screw cap and containing cloudy liquid, indicating a capped test tube is present on the shaking device.
